neighbours.label: descriptor in a title slot right before a named person (award-winning singer X, noted bookseller Y, former mayor Z)
fire: Tickets are on sale for an evening of songs with award-winning singer Maria Lopez next month.
Last week I spent an afternoon talking with noted historian David Hale about old maps.
The festival lineup features rising star Jenna Cole alongside several local bands.
The panel will be moderated by former mayor Tom Becker and two city planners.
Our guest tonight is acclaimed novelist Priya Raman, who just finished her third book.
The fundraiser was hosted by retired judge Alan Morris at the downtown library.
Students met with veteran journalist Karen Wu to discuss local reporting.
The workshop is led by celebrated chef Marco Bellini and his kitchen staff.
quiet: Tickets are on sale for an evening of songs at the award-winning concert hall next month.

notes: Top examples peak on the modifier before an appositive name (-winning, noted, rising, former, 'and').
